name: AK Turnip 1.14 Rutabaga
description: AK Turnip 1.14 Rutabaga: AK Turnip 1.14 plus native KGSL timeline synchronization (as in 1.13 Rutabaga). Timeline semaphores, binary semaphores, fences and queue submits use KGSL kernel timelines (IOCTL_KGSL_TIMELINE_*) instead of the emulated vk_sync_timeline + deferred-submit path, based on draft Mesa MR !39751 with AK fixes; falls back to the 1.14 sync path on kernels without KGSL timelines. Includes all 1.14 correctness fixes: descriptor-load speculation check for variable-count bindings, custom border color exhaustion, descriptor pool host-memory leak, debug-label stack growth, merged-submit binary wait flag, unsupported format features no longer advertised, device-creation failure paths, a630 CP_DRAW_AUTO workaround. No compiler or rendering changes. Built with platform-sdk-version=33.
author: aydar
